name: get_pouches
description: List the user's pouches with balance, spent today, limits and whether frozen.

user_token.description: REQUIRED fixed provider dynamic-variable binding from authenticated frontend user_token. Never generated by the LLM or requested from the user.

name: create_order
description: Build a draft cart from the user's request. Does not pay. Returns the cart and a `say` readback.

request.description: What the user asked for, in their words.

pouchId.description: Optional pouch to use; omit to let Solpouch choose.

user_token.description: REQUIRED fixed provider dynamic-variable binding from authenticated frontend user_token. Never generated by the LLM or requested from the user.

name: confirm_order
description: Pay for a draft cart. Only call after the user said yes to the exact cart that was read back.

user_token.description: REQUIRED fixed provider dynamic-variable binding from authenticated frontend user_token. Never generated by the LLM or requested from the user.

version.description: The exact order version returned for the cart the user reviewed. If it changed, read back the updated cart and ask for approval again.

user_token.description: REQUIRED fixed provider dynamic-variable binding from authenticated frontend user_token. Never generated by the LLM or requested from the user.

name: freeze_all
description: Freeze every pouch immediately. No more payments until the owner unfreezes in the app.

user_token.description: REQUIRED fixed provider dynamic-variable binding from authenticated frontend user_token. Never generated by the LLM or requested from the user.

name: prepare_demo_checkout
description: Only when the user asks to place or pay for a store estimate (create_order returned checkoutAvailable true). Turns it into a payable quote; does not pay. Read the say and wait for yes before confirm_order.

user_token.description: Fixed authenticated provider dynamic-variable binding; never generated by model.
